name: desktop-catalog-long-text
goal: Prevent repeated placeholder sentences in remaining Desktop long-content captures

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Image review rejected the GameLevelBrief long state: concatenated repeated concept and single repeated brief sentence. History long has the same fixture anti-pattern.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing component-catalog-previews long cases checked presence and layout only. Extend their shared post-capture guard to require three distinct sentences without adding cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 3e89b15b29d9de5160ced500006fcd82c2c6f0f585dc9c6cf9327e0e109221ab; all six existing long-state cases fail the distinct-sentence guard after preserving their screenshots.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use purposeful, spaced concept and level prose, and one detailed history event with several distinct sentences. Preserve the shared capture guard and existing case count.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Meaningful, spaced game concept/brief prose and one detailed history note replace repeated placeholders. The distinct-sentence guard stays unchanged in the normal catalog test.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
